disclosures.title: stc Annual Report 2025
disclosures.body_text: Official annual report covering group strategy, operations, sustainability, governance and audited consolidated financial statements.

disclosures.title: FY2025 subscriber and network update
disclosures.body_text: stc reported 30 million mobile subscribers, 6 million fixed subscribers, 63% 5G coverage and 25 data centers.

disclosures.title: AST SpaceMobile strategic agreement
disclosures.body_text: stc signed a strategic agreement with AST SpaceMobile to advance satellite-based telecommunications technologies.

disclosures.title: Government telecommunications infrastructure contract
disclosures.body_text: stc signed a SAR 32.64 billion contract with a government entity to build, operate and deliver telecommunications infrastructure. The preparation and execution period is 18 months, followed by a 15-year operation period; revenue recognition is expected to begin in Q4 2026.

disclosures.title: FY2025 distributions and dividend policy
disclosures.body_text: Cash dividends distributed during 2025 totaled SAR 21 billion, including regular quarterly distributions under the SAR 0.55 per-share policy and the SAR 2.00 per-share special dividend for FY2024.

disclosures.title: FY2025 governance framework and Board composition
disclosures.body_text: stc describes a Board-led governance framework aligned with Saudi Companies Law and CMA regulations, supported by Audit, Risk, Nomination and Remuneration, Executive and Investment committees.

disclosures.title: center3 data-center expansion plan
disclosures.body_text: center3 is executing a SAR 37.5 billion plan targeting 1 GW of data-center capacity by 2030.

disclosures.title: HUMAIN data-center joint venture
disclosures.body_text: stc disclosed a joint venture with HUMAIN targeting infrastructure capable of up to 1 GW, beginning with an initial deployment of up to 250 MW.

disclosures.title: Enterprise risk governance and risk appetite
disclosures.body_text: The Board Risk Committee oversees the enterprise risk management framework, strategies and policies. During 2025, stc reassessed and cascaded its risk appetite principles and metrics to subsidiaries to support a consolidated view of risk capacity and tolerance.

disclosures.title: Principal risks and controls
disclosures.body_text: stc reported principal risks including cybersecurity threats, data privacy, business continuity and regulatory change. Mitigations include centralized security monitoring and testing, privacy-by-design and access controls, network redundancy and disaster-recovery testing, and compliance monitoring.

disclosures.title: Risk monitoring, assurance and certifications
disclosures.body_text: stc reports quarterly principal-risk monitoring, enhanced automated risk indicators, risk and control self-assessments across critical business units and independent internal control review. It attained ISO 31000 enterprise risk management and ISO 27001 information security certifications.

disclosures.title: Government infrastructure contract revenue timing
disclosures.body_text: stc expects revenue recognition for the SAR 32.64 billion government telecommunications infrastructure contract to begin in Q4 2026 after an 18-month preparation and execution period, followed by 15 years of operation.

disclosures.title: center3 data-center capacity target
disclosures.body_text: center3 is executing a SAR 37.5 billion expansion plan targeting 1 GW of data-center capacity by 2030.

disclosures.title: Dividend policy through Q3 2027
disclosures.body_text: The approved policy provides for a regular quarterly dividend of SAR 0.55 per share from Q4 2024 through Q3 2027, with any special distributions subject to Board recommendation and General Assembly approval.

disclosures.title: 2030 emissions-reduction targets
disclosures.body_text: stc targets a 50% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions and a 46.2% reduction in Scope 3 emissions by 2030 from a 2019 baseline.

disclosures.title: Liquidity risk management
disclosures.body_text: stc manages liquidity risk by maintaining adequate reserves and banking facilities, monitoring forecast and actual cash flows and matching maturity profiles of financial assets and liabilities.

disclosures.title: Foreign currency risk
disclosures.body_text: The Group disclosed foreign-currency exposure arising from transactions and balances denominated in currencies other than Group entities' functional currencies and described its monitoring and hedging framework.

disclosures.title: Credit and counterparty risk
disclosures.body_text: The Group monitors credit risk quarterly, applies credit limits and approval controls, and disclosed concentration risk relating to trade receivables and financial counterparties.

disclosures.title: Government customer concentration
disclosures.body_text: Revenue from major Government-entity customers was approximately SAR 11.298 billion in 2025; no other single customer contributed 10% or more of Group revenue.

disclosures.title: Legal, regulatory and other provisions
disclosures.body_text: The Group reported SAR 1.278 billion of legal, regulatory and other provisions and SAR 127 million of decommissioning provisions at 31 December 2025.
